comment: The toolchains of fsm that no other file declares (S-44-2). Node.js is node of mise.toml and Rust rust-toolchain.toml. The php kind runs on PHP 8.4, whose dependencies resolve for config.platform.php of each composer.json. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs; mise.toml declares the tools it installs at the pins of kit (Go, Python with uv, govulncheck of the dependency review, cargo-audit of the Cargo locks, Composer, alint of make layout-check) and mise.lock locks them. The repository publishes no wheel, so it declares no pythonBackend.

bay.reason: bay pulls, starts and removes the servers of the persistence tests and runs their targets (docs/plans/fsm-v1/plan.md, C-6); its commands, its Compose keys and its JSON change with its release, so a run fails with another release than this one, and make bay-install installs the archive of this release by its digest on a runner of CI
bay.removal: when no target of fsm runs on a server of a container; the pin is raised, not removed, when a release of bay holds a correction that a run needs
